specs.title: the same component inputs produce the same public state in hydrate and CSR
duplicate, malformed, detached and mismatched roots are refused without mutation
hydrate before runtime startup preserves all static nodes
structural comparison detects a deliberate wrong HTML element
asynchronous browser work starts after deterministic attachment
disposing one hydrated scope releases its Owner and keeps peers interactive
independent CSR runtimes isolate identical geometry classes and their cleanup
